no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred to an advisory committee because there were no clinical efficacy or safety issues or controversial issues that would benefit from committee discussion.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the DARZALEX (daratumumab) BLA 761036 approval. The Division Director memo states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because there were no clinical efficacy, safety, or controversial issues warranting committee discussion, and both the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review ("No Advisory Committee meeting.") and the Medical Review ("This Application was not presented to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee or any other external consultants.") confirm this. Consequently there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
